title: Finite-presentation extension of ordinary scalar compatibility
statement: For the ordinary source and target functors of [new-s3-finite-perfect-adic-ordinary-scalar-components], any family of isomorphisms whose consecutive square commutes on the rank-one quotient module has the same commuting square for every quotient module.

proof.text: Prove small-colimit preservation of the ordinary target directly from its construction. ModuleCat.uliftFunctor preserves small colimits after forgetting to AddCommGrpCat, where this is Mathlib AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor; the module forgetful functor reflects these colimits. Constant module presheaves preserve colimits by evaluationJointlyReflectsColimits, and associated module sheafification is a left adjoint. Apply the normalized ordinary scalar-extension adjunction to completedAdicScalarExtension with its existing object and map equalities, and use the overPushforwardOverAdj slice adjunction. Scalar restriction, these constant and extension functors, and slice restriction therefore preserve small colimits.

For functors F,G out of R-modules with F preserving small colimits and epimorphisms, prove that two natural transformations equal on the regular module are equal everywhere. For N, use the concrete coproduct P=N ->0 R, with injections Finsupp.lsingle, whose colimit property is ModuleCat.finsuppCoconeIsColimit. After applying F its injections are jointly epic, so naturality and equality on R prove equality on P. The canonical freeDesc P -> N is surjective, since freeMk x maps to x. F preserves this epimorphism, and naturality and cancellation give equality on N. This uses arbitrary coproducts rather than a nonexistent finite presentation of an arbitrary N.

For each n, form the two natural transformations given by the two sides of the desired scalar square. Their common source is naturally isomorphic to the ordinary target at n, via finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarSourceStep followed by e n. Transport the small-colimit preservation from Step 1 to that source; pushout preservation also supplies preservation of epimorphisms. The assumed hunit n is precisely equality of the two components on the regular quotient module. Apply Step 2 and evaluate the resulting equality at N. Zero modules and zero coefficient rings are included in the same free surjection and coproduct argument.

theorem finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalar_compatibility
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (V : X.Etale) (U : V.left.ProEt) (W : X.ProEt)
    (f : W ⟶ finitePerfectAdicChartObject V U)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarSource X d V U W f n ≅
      finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarTarget X d W n)
    (hunit : ∀ (n : ℕ),
      (e (n + 1)).hom.app
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
            (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1))).obj
            (ModuleCat.of (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
              (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))) ≫
        (finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarTargetStep X d W n).hom.app
          (ModuleCat.of (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
            (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))) =
      (finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarSourceStep X d V U W f n).hom.app
          (ModuleCat.of (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
            (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))) ≫
        (e n).hom.app
          (ModuleCat.of (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
            (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (N : ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))),
      (e (n + 1)).hom.app
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
            (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1))).obj N) ≫
        (finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarTargetStep X d W n).hom.app N =
      (finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarSourceStep X d V U W f n).hom.app N ≫
        (e n).hom.app N
